sentences.en: Good morning, today I will discuss what is active learning, and, ah, what do active learners do.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。今天我要讨论什么是主动学习，以及主动学习者会做些什么。

sentences.en: In order to define active learning, I will look at the differences between active learning and passive learning by examining six characteristics of active learners and contrasting them with those of passive learners.
sentences.zh: 为了给主动学习下定义，我会考察主动学习者的六个特点，并将它们与被动学习者的特点作比较，从而说明主动学习和被动学习的区别。

sentences.en: OK, let’s start.
sentences.zh: 好，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: With the first characteristic, active learners tend to read with the purpose of understanding and remembering.
sentences.zh: 首先来看第一个特点：主动学习者往往以理解和记忆为目的进行阅读。

sentences.en: I bet that no one deliberately sits down to read with the purpose of not understanding the text.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，没有人坐下来阅读时，会故意以不理解文章为目的。

sentences.en: However, I am sure that some of you have been in a situation, probably more than once, where you read — quote and unquote — an assignment, closed the text and thought “what the world was that about?”
sentences.zh: 不过，我确信你们中有些人可能不止一次遇到过这种情况：所谓“读过了”布置的阅读材料，合上书，却在想：“刚才那到底讲了些什么？”

w.m: phr.所谓；给某词加引号以示保留

sentences.en: When you interact with a text in this manner, you are reading passively.
sentences.zh: 用这种方式接触文章，就是在被动阅读。

sentences.en: Active readers, on the other hand, set goals before they read and check their understanding as they read.
sentences.zh: 相反，主动阅读者会在阅读前设定目标，并在阅读过程中检查自己是否理解。

sentences.en: When they finish, they can explain the main points, and know that they have understood what they have read.
sentences.zh: 读完后，他们能够解释文章的要点，并且清楚自己已经理解了所读内容。

sentences.en: Now, the second characteristic of active learners is to reflect on information and think critically.
sentences.zh: 主动学习者的第二个特点，是反思所接收的信息，并进行批判性思考。

sentences.en: Being reflective is an important part of active learning because it means that you are thinking about the information.
sentences.zh: 善于反思是主动学习的重要组成部分，因为这意味着你正在思考所接收的信息。

sentences.en: In other words, you are processing the information.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你在对信息进行加工处理。

sentences.en: For instance, you may make connections between the new information and what you already know, identify concepts that you may not understand very well or evaluate the importance of what you are reading.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以把新信息与已有知识联系起来，找出自己可能不太理解的概念，或者评估所读内容的重要性。

sentences.en: An active learner reflects constantly in this way.
sentences.zh: 主动学习者会不断以这种方式进行反思。

sentences.en: In contrast, passive learners may read the text and listen to lectures and even understand most of what is read and heard, but they do not take that crucial next step of actually thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，被动学习者可能也读文章、听讲座，甚至理解大部分读到和听到的内容，但他们没有迈出至关重要的下一步：真正思考这些内容。

sentences.en: Let’s move onto the third one.
sentences.zh: 我们接着来看第三个特点。

sentences.en: The third characteristic is to listen actively by taking comprehensive notes in an organized way, like what you should be doing now.
sentences.zh: 第三个特点，是通过有条理地做全面的笔记来主动听讲，正如你们现在应该做的那样。

sentences.en: We lecturers are always amazed at the number of students who engage in activities other than listening and note-taking in their lecture classes.
sentences.zh: 我们这些讲课的老师总是很惊讶：竟然有那么多学生在课堂上做的事情与听讲、记笔记无关。

sentences.en: We’ve seen students reading newspapers, doing an assignment for another class, or chatting with their classmates.
sentences.zh: 我们见过有的学生读报纸，有的写另一门课的作业，还有的和同学聊天。

sentences.en: Perhaps the all-time winner for passive learning, however, was a student who regularly came to my class with a pillow and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 不过，要论最典型的被动学习者，可能要数那个经常带着枕头来我课堂上睡觉的学生了。

sentences.en: Unlike these students, active learners are engaged learners.
sentences.zh: 与这些学生不同，主动学习者会全身心投入学习。

sentences.en: They listen actively to the professor for the entire class period, and they write down as much information as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们在整节课中都会主动听老师讲课，并尽可能多地记录信息。

sentences.en: To be an active note taker, you must be more than simply present.
sentences.zh: 要成为主动做笔记的人，光是到场还不够。

sentences.en: You have to think about the information before you write.
sentences.zh: 在落笔之前，你必须先思考这些信息。

sentences.en: The fourth characteristic is to get assistance when they are experiencing problems.
sentences.zh: 第四个特点，是遇到问题时会寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Because active learners are constantly monitoring their understanding, they know when their comprehension breaks down, and they ask for help before they become lost.
sentences.zh: 因为主动学习者一直在检查自己的理解情况，所以他们知道自己何时出现理解障碍，并会在完全跟不上之前求助。

sentences.en: In addition, active learners often predict the courses, or even particular concepts within courses that may give them trouble.
sentences.zh: 此外，主动学习者经常会预判哪些课程，甚至课程中的哪些具体概念，可能给自己带来困难。

sentences.en: They have a plan in mind for getting assistance should they need it.
sentences.zh: 他们心中会预先想好：如果需要帮助，该到哪里去寻求。

sentences.en: Active learners may seek assistance from their professors or peers, although passive learners may seek help at some point, it is often too little, too late.
sentences.zh: 主动学习者可能会向老师或同学求助；被动学习者虽然也可能在某个时候求助，但往往已经为时过晚，所获帮助也不足以解决问题。

sentences.en: In addition, because passive learners do not reflect and think critically, they often don’t even realize that they need help.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于被动学习者不反思，也不进行批判性思考，他们经常甚至意识不到自己需要帮助。

sentences.en: The next characteristic is to question information.
sentences.zh: 下一个特点，是会对信息提出质疑。

sentences.en: This means that active learners raise questions on information that they read and hear, while passive learners accept both the printed page and the words of their professors as truth.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，主动学习者会对读到和听到的信息提出问题，而被动学习者则把书面材料和老师的话都当作真理接受。

sentences.en: Of course, active learners don’t question everything, but they do evaluate what they read and hear.
sentences.zh: 当然，主动学习者并非怀疑一切，但他们确实会评估读到和听到的内容。

sentences.en: When new information fails to fit in with what they already know, they may differ in the conclusions they draw or in the inferences they make.
sentences.zh: 当新信息与已有知识不吻合时，他们得出的结论或作出的推断可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: The last characteristic, which I think is the most fundamental one, is to accept much of the responsibility for learning.
sentences.zh: 最后一个特点，我认为也是最根本的一个，是主动承担学习的大部分责任。

sentences.en: Active learners understand that the responsibility for learning must come from within, while passive learners often want to blame others for their lack of motivation, poor performance, time management problems and other difficulties that they might experience.
sentences.zh: 主动学习者明白，学习的责任必须由自己承担；而被动学习者则往往想把自己缺乏动力、表现不佳、时间管理混乱及遇到的其他困难归咎于别人。

sentences.en: When active learners don’t perform as well as they’ve hoped, they evaluate why they didn’t do well and change those studying behaviors the next time.
sentences.zh: 当主动学习者表现没有达到预期时，他们会分析原因，并在下一次改变相应的学习行为。

sentences.en: Passive learners, on the other hand, often approach every course in the same manner, and then get angry with professors when their performance is poor.
sentences.zh: 相反，被动学习者经常用同一种方式对待每门课程，等到成绩不佳时，又生老师的气。

sentences.en: It is only when students accept the responsibility for their own learning that they can truly be called active learners.
sentences.zh: 只有学生愿意为自己的学习负责时，才真正称得上主动学习者。

sentences.en: So, from what I have said so far, you can see that being an active learner involves both skill and will.
sentences.zh: 从前面讲的内容可以看出，要成为主动学习者，既需要技能，也需要意愿。

sentences.en: By skill, I mean the tools to handle the studying and learning demands placed on you, like how to read with purpose, when and where to get assistance if you are having difficulty.
sentences.zh: 所谓技能，是指应对学习要求所需的方法，例如如何有目的地阅读，以及遇到困难时应在何时、向何处求助。

sentences.en: By will, I mean the desire and motivation to follow through.
sentences.zh: 所谓意愿，是指坚持做下去的愿望和动力。

sentences.en: Here I’d like to emphasize that skill is nothing without will.
sentences.zh: 这里我想强调，没有意愿，技能也发挥不了作用。

sentences.en: For example, you may have a friend who is knowledgeable, but not motivated in the classroom, even though he reads widely and can intelligently discuss a variety of issues, he does little school work and rarely studies.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可能有一位知识丰富、却在课堂上缺乏动力的朋友。他虽然阅读广泛，也能有见地地讨论各种问题，却很少做功课，也很少学习。

sentences.en: In other words, students, such as these, may have the skills to do well, but for some reason, they simply do not have the will.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这类学生或许具备学好的技能，却出于某些原因，就是没有那份意愿。

sentences.en: And because skill and will go hand in hand, unmotivated students, those who do not have the will, may experience difficulty in college.
sentences.zh: 而由于技能与意愿相辅相成，缺乏动力、也就是缺乏学习意愿的学生，在大学里可能会遇到困难。

sentences.en: OK, today we discuss the differences between an active learner and a passive one, and some useful study strategies that may eventually help you become an active learner.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们讨论了主动学习者和被动学习者的区别，以及一些实用的学习策略，希望最终能帮助大家成为主动学习者。

待核.en: what the world was that about?
待核.issue: PDF 第1页确实印作 what the world，常见表达为 what in the world；暂保留印本，须原音确认是否缺 in。
